name: Dual-Layer DDA Raycasting
definition: A 3D rendering technique using Digital Differential Analyzer (DDA) to cast rays through a 3D grid map, supporting two distinct vertical layers (worldMap[0] for top/ceiling, worldMap[1] for bottom/floor) to render both ceilings and floors simultaneously.
summary: Dual-Layer DDA Raycasting is a real-time voxel rendering technique that simultaneously determines ceiling and floor hits for each screen column within a single 3D grid traversal pass.
